visual.general_description: Two stacked box-plot panels comparing norepinephrine dose (A) and PaO2/FiO2 ratio (B) at TB and TA of hemoadsorption.
visual.detailed_description: Single image with two vertically stacked box-plot panels, A above B, each with a categorical x axis (TB, TA) and one box per category; panel A has one separate dot above the upper whisker in each category, panel B has none. No legend and no printed data labels.

panels.general_description: Pair of box-plots of norepinephrine dose at the TB and TA categories.
panels.detailed_description: Upper panel of the figure on a white background inside a pale blue-gray frame with the letter A printed at its top left. Y axis title reads "NE dose (ug/kg/day)" with printed ticks 0, 200, 400, 600 and 800; x axis has two categorical labels, TB and TA, with no axis title. Each category has one blue-gray filled box with a horizontal median line, thin whiskers above and below, and a single separate dark blue dot drawn above the upper whisker (one dot in each category). The TA upper whisker is longer than the TB one. No legend and no printed data labels.

evidence.quote: (A) Change in norepinephrine requirement during hemoadsorption.

clinical_significance.statement: Per the article text, the total norepinephrine dose decreased by the end of the course of hemoadsorption without reaching statistical significance.

evidence.quote: In the first 24 h the total dose of norepinephrine was 193.7 ug/kg/day [34.8–270.4] which decreased to 50.2 [6.5–243.5] ug/kg/day, by the end of the course of hemoadsorption, but did not reach statistical significance (Figure 1A).

limitations: Group-level box-plot; no individual patient values.

panels.general_description: Pair of box-plots of the PaO2/FiO2 ratio at the TB and TA categories.
panels.detailed_description: Lower panel of the figure on the same pale blue-gray frame with the letter B printed at its top left. Y axis title reads "PaO2/FiO2 (mmHg)" with printed ticks 50, 100, 150, 200, 250 and 300; x axis has two categorical labels, TB and TA, with no axis title. Each category has one blue-gray filled box with a horizontal median line and whiskers above and below; no separate dots are drawn. The TA box and its whiskers extend higher than the TB box and whiskers, and the TA lower whisker is longer. No legend and no printed data labels.
